candidate_bridge.semantic_intent: Expose the already-researched general-purpose function/call contract; do not introduce a new cognitive primitive.
candidate_bridge.authority_rule: Function definition/call resolution never mints capability or effect authority.
candidate_bridge.resolution_rule: Call target must resolve by explicit module/symbol/signature identity; no associative or nearest-neighbor fallback.

corpus.program: three typed composed expression-bodied functions: add, mul_add, twice_mix

repair_candidate: Materialize the previously researched function/call contract in the BASE canonical frontend/IR, beginning with an explicit typed function-definition production and exact signature binding. Keep branching/recursion/pattern matching/errors/concurrency as separate closure gates.
limitations: The experiment parser/checker is a deliberately small proxy, not the production G9 parser.

It does not test branching, recursion, pattern matching, structured error values, memory, async/concurrency, FFI, effects, native/WASM lowering or the mandatory application suite.
It ran on a hosted Debian Linux container, not the Andreas Ubuntu developer target.
No BASE work package or application proof is completed by this receipt.
